title: The Harvest of Old Chapel Road
author: Ivo Voss
blurb: Lena Reyes, an urban explorer mapping tunnels that aren't on any survey, has spent twelve years telling themselves the noises have explanations. But when every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
